page_title: SEV 2-2 RAY | Sevilla v Rayo Vallecano 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Having seen unsporting behavior, Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Joan Jordan (Sevilla) is the recipient.
90+6' 2 - 2 Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) manages to rise above the opponent's defenders to meet the well-taken corner kick with his head. His effort goes inside the right post. What a finish!
90+6' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+6' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+5' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
84' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Jesus Navas (Sevilla) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' It's time for a substitution. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Alvaro Garcia.
83' Francisco has decided to substitute Isi Palazon and he is replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oscar Valentin.
81' Jose Luis Mendilibar decides to make a substitution. Suso will be replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is coming onto the pitch as Juanlu Sanchez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' The Sevilla players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
74' What was Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
72' Suso (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
71' The current number of corner kicks is 11:2.

71' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
70' Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
69' That's the end of the game for Raul de Tomas, who is replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
67' Suso (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
66' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes a short corner kick.
65' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Suso (Sevilla) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Stole Dimitrievski has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
62' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

61' A snap shot by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski produces a good save to thwart him. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Suso (Sevilla) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
58' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.

58' A sweet pass inside the box gives Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
56' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Trejo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
54' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' A cross into the box from Loic Bade (Sevilla) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
54' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' The attendance is 35817.
50' 1 - 2 Djibril Sow (Sevilla) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes in off the post and the score changes to 1:2.
50' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

48' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) latches onto a nice cross into the area around the penalty spot, but plants his header just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
47' The game is interrupted. Loic Bade (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' Half-time substitution. Oliver Torres is replaced by Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla).
46' Jose Luis Mendilibar makes a half-time substitution. Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) comes on in place of Marcos Acuna.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+6' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+5' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Stole Dimitrievski. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+4' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+3' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
45+3' Loic Bade (Sevilla) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
42' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
40' Sevilla fail to score from a corner as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.
39' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' We are about to witness a substitution. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is replacing Fernando.
37' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
36' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
35' Rayo Vallecano enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

33' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
33' Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
31' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
30' The game is interrupted now, Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' 0 - 2 What a goal that is! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Orjan Nyland and into the net. 0:2.
26' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:1.
20' Fernando (Sevilla) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
19' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul after Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

19' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
18' Suso (Sevilla) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

17' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the right side of the goal, but Orjan Nyland pulls off a great save to deny him.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
16' An attempted cross from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
12' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
12' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Handball by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla).
9' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano).
9' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
7' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

6' A bullet header by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
5' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera will referee today's match.
